Q1.purpose: Monthly count of landing_404 errors for paid_social traffic
Q1.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(landing_404s) AS total_404s
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic
WHERE source = 'paid_social'
  AND to_date(date) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

Q2.purpose: Monthly gap between paid_social ad clicks and site sessions
Q2.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(m.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(m.clicks) AS total_clicks,
       SUM(w.sessions) AS total_sessions,
       SUM(m.clicks) - SUM(w.sessions) AS click_session_gap
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend m
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic w
  ON m.date = w.date
 AND m.channel = 'paid_social'
 AND w.source = 'paid_social'
WHERE to_date(m.date) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

Q4.purpose: Monthly paid_social conversion rate (orders per session) for Aug‑Sep 2026
Q4.sql:
SELECT date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(CAST(o.quantity AS DOUBLE)) AS total_orders,
       SUM(CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sessions,
       SUM(CAST(o.quantity AS DOUBLE)) / SUM(CAST(t.sessions AS DOUBLE)) AS conversion_rate
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic t
  ON to_date(o.date) = to_date(t.date)
WHERE o.channel = 'paid_social'
  AND to_date(o.date) >= to_date('2026-08-01')
  AND to_date(o.date) < to_date('2026-10-01')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

Q7.purpose: Monthly cost efficiency metrics for paid social (meta) ads: CPC and CPM
Q7.sql:
WITH spend_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
         SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
         SUM(spend_usd) AS spend_usd
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend
  WHERE channel = 'meta'
    AND date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND date < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       spend_usd,
       clicks,
       CASE WHEN clicks = 0 THEN 0 ELSE spend_usd / clicks END AS cpc,
       CASE WHEN impressions = 0 THEN 0 ELSE spend_usd / (impressions/1000.0) END AS cpm
FROM spend_monthly
ORDER BY month;

Q9.purpose: Monthly paid social orders and revenue, plus derived ROAS and orders per dollar
Q9.sql:
WITH orders_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS orders,
         SUM(unit_price_usd * quantity) AS revenue
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
  WHERE channel = 'paid_social'
    AND date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND date < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
),
spend_monthly AS (
  SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         SUM(spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
         SUM(clicks) AS clicks
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend
  WHERE channel = 'meta'
    AND date >= '2026-08-01'
    AND date < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT o.month,
       o.orders,
       o.revenue,
       s.spend_usd,
       s.clicks,
       CASE WHEN s.clicks = 0 THEN 0 ELSE s.spend_usd / s.clicks END AS cpc,
       CASE WHEN s.spend_usd = 0 THEN 0 ELSE o.revenue / s.spend_usd END AS roas,
       CASE WHEN s.spend_usd = 0 THEN 0 ELSE o.orders / s.spend_usd END AS orders_per_spend
FROM orders_monthly o
JOIN spend_monthly s ON o.month = s.month
ORDER BY o.month;

Q10.purpose: Compare monthly refund rates for paid_social orders versus other channels in August and September 2026.
Q10.sql:
SELECT o.channel,
       date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.amount_usd, 0)) AS total_refund,
       SUM(COALESCE(r.amount_usd, 0)) / SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS refund_rate
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY o.channel, month
ORDER BY o.channel, month

Q11.purpose: Compare the proportion of quality‑related support tickets for paid_social orders versus other channels in August and September 2026.
Q11.sql:
SELECT o.channel,
       date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS total_tickets,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.category IN ('product quality', 'not as described') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quality_tickets,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.category IN ('product quality', 'not as described') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS quality_ticket_pct
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
JOIN WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets t ON o.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY o.channel, month
ORDER BY o.channel, month

Q12.purpose: Compare monthly ad spend, sessions, orders and revenue for paid_social (meta) in August vs September 2026
Q12.sql:
SELECT
  date_format(to_date(ms.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
  SUM(ms.spend_usd) AS total_spend_usd,
  SUM(wt.sessions) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'paid_social' THEN o.quantity * o.unit_price_usd END) AS total_revenue_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'paid_social' THEN o.quantity END) AS total_orders
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend ms
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
  ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(wt.date)
  AND ms.channel = wt.source
  AND ms.date = wt.date
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(o.date)
  AND ms.channel = o.channel
WHERE ms.date >= '2026-08-01' AND ms.date < '2026-10-01'
  AND ms.channel = 'meta'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

Q13.purpose: Check stability of CPC and ROAS month‑over‑month for paid_social
Q13.sql:
SELECT
  month,
  cpc,
  roas,
  LAG(cpc) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_cpc,
  LAG(roas) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_roas,
  (cpc - LAG(cpc) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(cpc) OVER (ORDER BY month),0) AS cpc_pct_change,
  (roas - LAG(roas) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(roas) OVER (ORDER BY month),0) AS roas_pct_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(ms.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    SUM(ms.spend_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(wt.sessions),0) AS cpc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'paid_social' THEN o.quantity * o.unit_price_usd END) / NULLIF(SUM(ms.spend_usd),0) AS roas
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend ms
  LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
    ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(wt.date)
    AND ms.channel = wt.source
    AND ms.date = wt.date
  LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(o.date)
    AND ms.channel = o.channel
  WHERE ms.date >= '2026-08-01' AND ms.date < '2026-10-01'
    AND ms.channel = 'meta'
  GROUP BY month
) t
ORDER BY month;

Q14.purpose: Assess whether spend is proportional to paid_social sessions and orders (spend per session and spend per order)
Q14.sql:
SELECT
  month,
  spend_usd,
  paid_social_sessions,
  paid_social_orders,
  spend_usd / NULLIF(paid_social_sessions,0) AS spend_per_session_usd,
  spend_usd / NULLIF(paid_social_orders,0) AS spend_per_order_usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(ms.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    SUM(ms.spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
    SUM(wt.sessions) AS paid_social_sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'paid_social' THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS paid_social_orders
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend ms
  LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic wt
    ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(wt.date)
    AND ms.channel = wt.source
    AND ms.date = wt.date
  LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON to_date(ms.date) = to_date(o.date)
    AND ms.channel = o.channel
  WHERE ms.date >= '2026-08-01' AND ms.date < '2026-10-01'
    AND ms.channel = 'meta'
  GROUP BY month
) sub
ORDER BY month;

   (SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END),0) AS pct_change

Q20.purpose: Examine revenue per order by country for the top 5 countries in August, to see if lower‑priced geographies drove the September change
Q20.sql:
WITH orders_month AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         country,
         unit_price_usd * quantity AS revenue
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
  WHERE channel = 'paid_social'
    AND to_date(date) >= '2026-08-01'
    AND to_date(date) < '2026-09-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
         country,
         unit_price_usd * quantity AS revenue
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
  WHERE channel = 'paid_social'
    AND to_date(date) >= '2026-09-01'
    AND to_date(date) < '2026-10-01'
),
country_agg AS (
  SELECT country,
         month,
         SUM(revenue) AS total_rev,
         COUNT(*) AS orders_cnt,
         SUM(revenue) / COUNT(*) AS rev_per_order
  FROM orders_month
  GROUP BY country, month
),
top_countries AS (
  SELECT country,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_rev DESC) AS rn
  FROM country_agg
  WHERE month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT ca.country,
       ca.month,
       ca.total_rev,
       ca.orders_cnt,
       ca.rev_per_order
FROM country_agg ca
JOIN top_countries tc ON ca.country = tc.country AND tc.rn <= 5
WHERE ca.month IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
ORDER BY ca.country, ca.month;
